title: Splunk REST Endpoint Atlas

availability_legend.on_prem_only: Enterprise/on-prem only; Cloud blocks it or handles it via ACS (for SOAR: on-prem only)

path_notes: Paths joined by ' · ' in the page are split into the paths array. Short forms like 'tcp/raw' share the prefix of the first path in the row.

core.name: Core Splunk (splunkd)
core.cloud_base_url: https://<stack>.splunkcloud.com:8089/services/ (IP must be on the ACS search-api allow list)
core.notes: Add output_mode=json. POST creates or updates; no PUT.

ds.name: Deployment server & clients
ds.notes: On-prem only. Client endpoints run on the forwarder. Run deployment/server/config/_reload after serverclass changes.

dbx.name: Splunk DB Connect
dbx.notes: dbxproxy endpoints take JSON bodies and use PUT to update. They are not in Splunk's published REST reference; paths come from Splunk Community posts, and outputs/lookups are assumed to follow the same pattern.

es.name: Mission Control public v2 API (Enterprise Security 8)
es.notes: The 'path' values are official operation IDs, not URLs. Get exact URL templates from missioncontrol/mcopenapi.yaml. GET endpoints work with | rest when you add search_format=true.

mc.name: Mission Control v1 Automation API (ES 7 + Mission Control)
mc.notes: The 'operation_ids' values are official operation IDs; the spec is mc_openapi.json. Legacy API; use the public v2 API on ES 8.

soar.name: Splunk SOAR
soar.notes: Query params: _filter_<field>, page, page_size, sort, order. POST to /rest/<type>/<id> updates.
